evidence_record.title: Leave-club has split monetary commits and continues after failures.
evidence_record.observation: `leave-club.js:163-219` credits held cashouts through fn_credit_chips, then separately changes cashout status without a pending-state condition. Failure after credit leaves a retryable request; a failed credit merely continues. `:225-278` separately debits player and credits treasury; either error logs and continues. `:323-338` deletes membership regardless of those earlier financial failures. There is no caller transaction or durable recovery obligation joining these steps. `:448` reports all selected cashouts as cancelled even when loop iterations failed. A deleted-membership failure receipt `:335-336` asserts chips were returned without checking that movement succeeded. SQL triggers/constraints could limit effects but cannot be presumed. Controls: L02/L05 atomic custody, L04/L11 recovery, truthful receipt.
